title: eaglhuang/AI-Atomic-Framework
summary: AI-Atomic-Framework是一个基于TypeScript的框架，通过5D CID身份、7阶段生命周期、SHA256锚定的闭包证据和原子映射，实现N个编码代理并发修改一个仓库，提供了一种确定性的AI治理层，旨在确保裸AI编码的安全性。，基于模型推理的架构
description: The safety brake for naked AI coding. A deterministic governance layer that lets N coding agents concurrently mutate one repo — via 5D CID identity, a 7-stage lifecycle, SHA256-anchored closure evidence, and atom maps that retire legacy modules through a gated replacement lifecycle.
